$comment: ProofGate for Tandem. Without this it cannot see the suite: Tandem is a shell project with its own runner, and automatic detection only knows ecosystems that have a manifest (package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod...). Without this line the gate went green without running a single test - exactly the kind of empty approval the skill exists to prevent.

commands.typecheck: bash -c 'for f in src/bin/* src/lib/*.sh tests/*.sh debian/postinst debian/postrm; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done; python3 -m py_compile src/lib/*.py tools/*.py build.py'
commands.lint: shellcheck --shell=bash --exclude=SC1091,SC2123 --severity=warning src/bin/* src/lib/*.sh tests/*.sh debian/postinst debian/postrm

$comment_source: Tandem's code lives in src/ and tools/; debian/ carries the installation scripts, which are code too.
$comment_coupled: Files that only make sense together. Changing one and forgetting the other has already happened in this repository: the version lives in four places, and a package with a new version and an old changelog is rejected by lintian.

coupledFiles.reason: a new version requires a new changelog entry with a fresh date - lintian fails without it
a new command has to appear in the manual, otherwise the package documents one thing and does another
the DLL->verb table has already had six errors that installed the wrong thing; changing it without a test is walking without the auditor

$comment_pii: There is no personal data here, but there is one thing that must never leak into the log: the path of somebody else's Wine prefix next to a write command.
$comment_money: Tandem does not handle money. Switched off so it does not generate noise.
